historicalRegression.idempotenceScope: Selected-policy entry transforms and repeated conversion from the exact pinned source; derived world ZIPs are not download inputs.
historicalRegression.payloadComparison: Every ZIP entry byte-identical between compiled original r16 source and production r17 output, excluding compatibility-marker entry. Both harness copies use the same accepted enum metadata.

marker.reason: Legacy-to-native source policy changes actual production conversion, including fixing target treasure_hunter tag codec breakage. Source SHA1 invalidates historical→target copies, but same target-source r16 converted world copies would otherwise remain accepted; r17 invalidates those copies. RootOverrideSha1 continues to record bundled root content changes independently.

nativeHardcoreProbe.idempotenceScope: Selected-policy entry transforms and repeated conversion from the exact pinned source; derived world ZIPs are not download inputs.
nativeHardcoreProbe.proof: Every native entry compared against independent recursive reward-namespace-scoped announcement-only expected structure; all functions and unrelated entries byte-identical; no needless JSON serialization.

nativeMainProbe.idempotenceScope: Selected-policy entry transforms and repeated conversion from the exact pinned source; derived world ZIPs are not download inputs.
nativeMainProbe.proof: Every native entry compared against independent recursive reward-namespace-scoped announcement-only expected structure; all functions and unrelated entries byte-identical; no needless JSON serialization.

sourceDiscriminator.discriminator: Exact independently verified source ZIP SHA1, using main1.21 and official Hardcore1.21 identity when selected; not arbitrary filename/version-string/pack-format heuristics. Historical fixture/archive hashes continue through legacy conversion.
sourceDiscriminator.exactSelectionRule: Compute Utils.calculateSHA1(sourcePack) once before ZIP traversal; native policy only when actual source bytes hash to mainSha1 or hardcoreSha1. Do not select by the updated enum SHA1 alone: frozen historical inputs must still select historical conversion when inspected through test metadata.
sourceDiscriminator.plannedChange: In copyForWorld determine native verified source once before ZIP loop. Native mcfunction copies pass-through. Native JSON parse/traverse solely existing announcement suppression; leave all criteria/references unchanged and preserve source bytes when no announcement change. Historical convertJson/convertFunction implementation remains intact. Retain original String-signature methods for existing historical regressions; use a narrow overload/helper for native policy. Compute native identity from actual source ZIP bytes once, using Utils.calculateSHA1(sourcePack) and the two exact SHA1 constants; no filename/enum-only trust.
sourceDiscriminator.scope: Main BACAP1.21 and Hardcore1.21 only. Historical variants and all other sources retain existing conversion. No broad metadata heuristic.
